instruction: Configure a local filter in Thunderbird to forward all emails received by anonym-x2024@outlook.com to secondary-inbox@outlook.com. Don't change the online account settings, only set up the filter in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (secondary-inbox@outlook.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is secondary-inbox@outlook.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird filter configuration file from account-specific path
Metric correctly parses msgFilterRules.dat file format and validates all filter properties
All instruction requirements are verified: forward action, target email (secondary-inbox@outlook.com), apply to all emails (condition ALL), and filter enabled
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window to ensure filter is saved before verification
Expected values accurately match instruction requirements
Account scoping is correctly handled via file path (outlook.office365.com folder) - filters in this file apply to that specific account

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
